# اِسْتَرَثْتَ (istaraṯta) /is.ta.raθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
# اِسْتَرَثْتِ (istaraṯti) /is.ta.raθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
# اُسْتُرِثْتُ (usturiṯtu) /us.tu.riθ.tu/: first-perso
